name: suiko
description: Suiko: an iterative, commentable, versioned review loop for the HTML and Markdown documents AI agents write.

plugins.name: suiko
plugins.description: Review the documents Claude writes (reports, specs, plans; HTML or Markdown) in a local UI, send located feedback, get changes to exactly what you commented on and see what changed. Adds the spec-review skill, /review-spec, /review-code, /suiko-last, and the Write and prompt hooks.
